name: Directory Navigation
description: Scopes the session strictly to the current working directory as a named project, resisting drift to other paths and surfacing the project's latest handoff on resume.

redirectStrictness.label: Redirect Strictness
redirectStrictness.description: How TPM handles a path outside the bound project. ask (default): confirm before treating it as in-scope. hard-block: refuse until this mode is disabled. soft-warn: warn once and proceed.

projectNoteSections.label: Project Note Sections
projectNoteSections.description: Comma-separated top-level sections for the project notes file, in write order. Session Handoff is managed by tool.session-handoff; the section format itself is defined by tool.obsidian-notes.
projectNoteSections.default: Project Overview, Sessions, Decisions, Open Questions, Session Handoff

autoCreateNotesFile.label: Auto Create Notes File
autoCreateNotesFile.description: When on (default), TPM auto-creates the project notes file on first run if it doesn't exist. When off, TPM only reads existing files and notes when none is found.

projectNameSource.label: Project Name Source
projectNameSource.description: How TPM derives the project's identity. git-remote (default): keys off the origin remote so multiple clones share one home, falling back to the cwd basename if there's no remote. cwd-basename: always keys per-directory.

projectHomeName.label: Project Home Name
projectHomeName.description: Optional explicit name for the project's notes home; overrides all automatic naming when set. Not needed for the common rename case, since a home already matching the cwd basename is preserved automatically. Leave blank to let TPM resolve it automatically.

consolidateSiblings.label: Consolidate Sibling Notes
consolidateSiblings.description: When on (default), TPM scans for sibling notes about this project at session start and offers to fold them into the single home; old files are kept, never deleted. Underscore-prefixed vault areas like _AgentComms are never scanned.

overflowThresholdLines.label: Overflow Threshold (lines)
overflowThresholdLines.description: When the notes file exceeds this many lines, TPM proposes splitting it into a directory home (once per session, never done silently). Set to 0 to disable.

overflowThresholdKb.label: Overflow Threshold (KB)
overflowThresholdKb.description: When the notes file exceeds this many KB, TPM proposes promoting it to a directory home (whichever threshold trips first). Set to 0 to disable.

projectNicknames.label: Project Nicknames
projectNicknames.description: Optional comma-separated extra name tokens used to detect sidecar files for this project, beyond the home name itself. Leave blank to match on the home name only.
